spans.s: यः The 3rd consonant of a Varga.
(in music) N. of measure. -यम् A third part; वनेषु च विहृत्यैवं तृतीयं भागमायुषः
. ind. For the 3rd time, thirdly; तृतीयमप्सु नृमणा अजस्रम्
.-Comp. -करणी the side of a square 3 times smaller than another. -प्रकृतिः m. or f.
तृतीया [tṛtīyā], 1 The third day of a lunar fortnight.
(In gram.) The instrumental case or its terminations. -Comp. -कृत a. thrice ploughed (as a field).-तत्पुरुषः the instrumental Tatpuruṣa. -प्रकृतिः m., f.
Recurring every third day, tertian (as a fever).
Entitled to a third portion (of inheritance &c.); विषमा ह्येषामाख्या । केचिदर्धिनः केचित् तृतीयिनः केचित् पादिनः इति । ŚB. on
